title: JellyGlazed Mediterranean Pork Skillet
description: A quick winey glaze coats tender pork shoulder steaks, finished with pickled cucumbers for a refreshing Mediterranean bite.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and drizzle olive oil, then sear the pork steaks until browned on both sides, about 3 minutes per side.
Remove the steaks and set aside, then pour red wine into the same skillet to deglaze, scraping up browned bits.
Stir in apricot jam, lemon juice, rosemary, salt, and pepper, letting the mixture simmer until it thickens into a glaze, about 5 minutes.
Return the pork to the skillet, spooning glaze over the steaks, and cook until the internal temperature reaches 145°F, about 4 minutes per side.
While the pork finishes, heat pickled cucumber slices in a small saucepan until warm, about 3 minutes.
Slide the cooked pork onto a cutting board, then drizzle remaining glaze over the top.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the dish and serve immediately with the warmed pickled cucumbers on the side.
Optional: Garnish with additional rosemary sprigs for aroma.
